claims.title: Convex quadratic program and attainment
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Kernel-check compact attainment and Jensen convexity, then audit 48 independent quadratic forms and reject a negated-squared-norm control.
claims.limitation: Paper-specific continuity and lower-semicontinuity are explicit premises.

claims.title: Pseudometric and dispersion gap
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Kernel-check weighted Minkowski and conditional variance, enumerate 320 declared cells and 32 witnesses, and reject a squared-discrepancy triangle control.
claims.limitation: Finite checks do not replace the population theorem.

claims.title: Synthetic Table 2 method ordering
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Run N=2000, 100 trials, T=200, alpha=0.5, preserve all 300 method rows, and require both paired interval upper endpoints below zero.
claims.limitation: Seeds, initialization, and CDOT step-size policy are disclosed independent choices.

claims.title: OASIS-3 cohort and Table 3
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Hash and parse all 975 archive sessions and 696 subjects, identify OAS30938 with a 168-node session, preserve 19,800 all-pair rows, and reject fabricated padding.
claims.limitation: The cohort invariant is falsified; directional rerun values and the literal premise are separate evidence.

claims.title: TUDataset graph classification
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Run all graph pairs, the published alpha/C/gamma grids, nested stratified CV, three outer seeds, and permuted-label controls; ENZYMES reverses CDOT and FGW.
claims.limitation: Several preprocessing and stopping choices are unpublished and remain protocol risks.

claims.title: Risk bound and consistency
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Kernel-check the E1+E2+E3 bound, optimization rate, consistency squeeze, and invalid T_n=n control, then run two diagnostic panels.
claims.limitation: Measure, operator, and empirical-process assumptions remain explicit premises.
